notes: C10 publishes the runtime contract and HTTP/worker composition. Peer bodies stay with their owners. Extra RequestSpec keys declared_documentary and search_policy.target_degree are optional additive fields.

handoffs.acceptance_case: ingest_market(file_bytes, filename, request_spec) returns InputBundle; roles/target already on request_spec; no silent name collision resolution.
categorical subject raw_values and sample_ledger survive; encoder_state is declarative.
C10 maps fundamentacao/precisao/documentary onto the snapshot without recomputing grades; issuance stays draft.
CandidateAssessment.value has the exact ResultSnapshot value shape; point is not rebuilt from arbitration.
progress_callback is sync and light; cancel_requested() is bool; search_audit records possible/generated/evaluated/rejected.

handoffs.required_callsite: backend.worker.compose_valuation_job when evaluation_policy.method is not none
handoffs.acceptance_case: fit_select_predictor(train_row_ids, seed) wraps fit_dataset+search_models; reserved-set error is not used to filter.
render_report(snapshot, report_context) -> bytes. Failure must not unwind the snapshot. report_context carries used/excluded row ids and request dates.

create(idempotency_key=, project_id=, request_spec=, input_sha256=, code_sha=) returns {job_id,state}; update_transition(job_id, expected, new, patch=); save_snapshot/get_snapshot; save_artifact/get_artifact; recover_abandoned; LocalTaskRunner(job_store).submit(job_id, callable) / cancel(job_id); callable may accept cancel_requested=.
Failure is isolated; artifact hash stays off the frozen snapshot.
Receives a validated draft snapshot; C10 aggregates next_actions then freezes.
POST /projects/{id}/batch submits one evaluate_batch call via LocalTaskRunner; not an unbounded gather loop. frozen_project is the C10 mapping.

handoffs.exported_interface: POST /jobs 202 {job_id,status_url}; GET /jobs/{id}; GET /jobs/{id}/result; POST /preview; GET artifacts; /upload adapter now 202 (not 200-on-error)
handoffs.required_callsite: frontend/app.py currently posts /upload and waits on WebSocket for PDF/base64
handoffs.acceptance_case: UI must treat 202 as accepted, poll GET for snapshot, and not require report_pdf_base64 on the WebSocket. calculation_state vs artifact_states must both be shown.
